title: Repair Pullback Learning retired entry-state dependency
objective: Repair the existing adaptive Pullback Learning owner so it is not permanently dead after the canonical retirement of GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE, while preserving the intended regime/context boundary and research-only authority. First discover whether a pre-existing non-binding research eligibility/context owner already expresses when pullback learning may classify risk/reload states. If one exists, bind to it explicitly and fail closed on missing/stale evidence. If no such owner exists, do not invent a new market/regime rule; keep classification fail-closed and escalate the missing eligibility contract to the framework owner. Regardless, continue truthful observation collection only if existing owner semantics permit it, and do not allow the retired entry/breadth gate to regain action, rebuy, canonical-state or portfolio authority.
allowed_change_scope: tests/pullback_learning/directly related runtime eligibility, liveness and authority tests
04_MARKET_LEARNING/pullback_learning/directly related non-canonical documentation or machine-readable status artifact only if an existing owner pattern requires it
.github/workflows/pullback-learning-ledger.yml only if strictly required to preserve the existing owner contract; workflow modification requires current repository-safety safepoint

evidence.summary: Current classify() computes entry_active = current_obs.get('entry_state') == 'GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE' and returns REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE whenever false, so all pullback risk/reload classifications are unreachable after the retired state became non-permitted.
Current runtime output is REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE while still collecting adaptive observations; current market_snapshot carries entry_state WAIT after the post-retirement Entry Ledger changes.

Canonical follow-up binds the legacy Entry observer ACTIVE state to explicit promotion status and keeps current promotion fail-closed; source-quality or proxy breadth cannot silently restore the retired breadth/entry gate.
A separate intraday owner has the same root retirement dependency but a different allowed scope. This candidate intentionally does not duplicate that task and targets Pullback Learning only.

reproduction: On fresh main, read scripts/pullback_learning/pullback_learning_ledger.py and confirm classify() still requires entry_state == GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE before any PULLBACK_RISK_RESEARCH, PULLBACK_ACTIVE_RESEARCH, RELOAD_WATCH_RESEARCH or NORMAL regime classification can be reached. Read the current Entry Ledger/canonical post-#657 semantics and confirm that legacy ACTIVE is not currently permitted. Read current pullback LATEST/STATE and confirm REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE while observations continue. Search current canonical/research owners for an already authorized research-only regime/eligibility context before proposing any replacement. Stop as clean no-op if a newer current-main fix already removes the dead dependency safely.

positive: A fixture using an already-existing eligible research-only context, if such an owner is discovered, can reach the appropriate non-canonical Pullback Learning classification without requiring GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE.
Observation collection and descriptive adaptive statistics remain reproducible and preserve historical rows; missing required context fails closed rather than fabricating eligibility.
Current research_only=true, portfolio_execution=false, canonical_market_state=false and automatic_rule_changes=false boundaries remain explicit in state/latest outputs.

If no pre-existing eligible context owner exists, implementation stops short of inventing one and emits/escalates an explicit eligibility-contract gap rather than silently keeping a logically impossible ACTIVE dependency.
negative: Proxy breadth, legacy entry conditions or canonical_compatible source quality alone cannot reactivate pullback classification authority.
GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE cannot be restored, reinterpreted or recreated as a hidden prerequisite or alias.
Pullback research state cannot unlock portfolio action, rebuy, canonical market state, market gates, thresholds or automatic promotion.
Do not use direction-confidence/T12 or another shadow forecast as a substitute regime permission unless a current owner explicitly authorizes that relationship.
Do not rewrite historical observations/episodes/outcomes or create a second pullback engine.

clean_noop_condition: A newer current-main owner already repairs the Pullback Learning dependency with an existing legitimate research-only eligibility contract, or the Pullback Learning owner has been explicitly retired/superseded.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if candidate hash/status/authority changes, fresh reproduction fails, the required replacement would exceed allowed_change_scope, or no pre-existing eligible research context exists and remediation would require inventing new market/regime policy semantics.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if no existing research-only eligibility owner can replace the retired dependency, or if repair would require new market gates, thresholds, canonical authority, portfolio/rebuy logic, model weights, API budget or new policy semantics.
